m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md), project deltas if present (docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, GLOSSARY.md), the handoff, and the relevant source files. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). If incomplete, block and return. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + handoff loaded; handoff complete
postconditions.satisfied_by: global-crew/everyone doctrine + CREW_CONTEXT/GLOSSARY present + handoff read in full; handoff complete: task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions all present

m1-schema.title: Extend session_surface_features DDL in both locations
m1-schema.imperative: Add wet_lap_count INTEGER, total_lap_count INTEGER, wet_lap_fraction REAL to session_surface_features in src/data/schema.sql AND the mirrored CREATE TABLE in src/data/database/_core.py::_apply_schema_upgrades. Evidence: fresh DB gets the columns.

postconditions.statement: fresh DB session_surface_features has the three wet columns

check.command: py -c "from src.data.database import DatabaseManager; import tempfile,os,sqlite3; p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'t.db'); DatabaseManager(db_path=p); c=sqlite3.connect(p); print(sorted(r[1] for r in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(session_surface_features)')))"

payload.cmd: py -c "from src.data.database import DatabaseManager; import tempfile,os,sqlite3; p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'t.db'); DatabaseManager(db_path=p); c=sqlite3.connect(p); print(sorted(r[1] for r in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(session_surface_features)')))"

m2-migration.title: Idempotent ALTER-TABLE migration for old-schema DBs
m2-migration.imperative: In _core.py::_apply_schema_upgrades, add PRAGMA table_info(session_surface_features) guard + conditional ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for each new wet column (skip when table absent — executescript creates it new; only ALTER when table exists but lacks the column). Follow the existing sessions-table migration block shape. Test-after: an old-schema table gains the columns after migration, idempotently, preserving existing rows.

preconditions.satisfied_by: schema DDL extended in both locations; m1 complete

postconditions.statement: migration test passes: old-schema table gains columns idempotently, old values preserved

m3-detection.title: Pure wet-fraction detection function (TDD)
m3-detection.imperative: TEST-FIRST: write hand-computed detection tests (all-dry->0.0; mixed->count/total; all-inter->1.0; empty->None fraction) then implement session_wet_lap_features in src/data/weather_features.py next to _session_rain_flag, reusing DatabaseManager.get_lap_times(session_id=...) and the WET/INTERMEDIATE case-insensitive criterion. Returns (wet_lap_count, total_lap_count, wet_lap_fraction).

postconditions.statement: detection tests pass with hand-computed fractions

m4-upsert.title: Non-clobbering ON CONFLICT wet-columns upsert
m4-upsert.imperative: Add DatabaseManager.upsert_session_wet_features(session_id, wet_lap_count, total_lap_count, wet_lap_fraction) in _ingest.py using INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET wet_*=excluded.wet_* — owns ONLY the new columns, never touches session_rain_flag/dry_laps_*/gap_rain_flag/feature_status. Do NOT reuse INSERT OR REPLACE. Test-after: writing wet columns leaves a pre-existing session_rain_flag/feature_status intact; fresh row gets wet cols with others NULL. STOP if ON CONFLICT cannot preserve sibling columns.
constraints: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE only, no INSERT OR REPLACE

m5-populator.title: All-seasons populator + CLI, run on real DBs
m5-populator.imperative: Add a populator (iterate 'R' sessions in a season DB, upsert wet columns each) plus runnable scripts/populate_wet_features.py running over data/f1_data_{year}.db for a year (default 2019-2026 sweep): idempotent, resumable, timestamped logging, DB read-write for the target season only, DB-only. Run it against the real 2019-2026 DBs and capture the verification values (Spain 0.0; Silverstone 2024 ~0.24 / 2025 ~0.74; Monaco 2023 ~0.29).

postconditions.statement: populator runs over 2019-2026 real DBs; verification wet-fractions reproduce

m6-physics.title: Physics consumer helper + validation exclude-wet path
m6-physics.imperative: In src/physics/burn_rate_calibration.py add read-only session_wet_fraction(year, gp_name, lap_times_db_path)->Optional[float] reading the STORED session_surface_features.wet_lap_fraction for the 'R' session (None if column/row absent; do NOT recompute compounds). Add a named module-level WET_EXCLUDE_THRESHOLD=0.05. In scripts/validate_burn_rate_hypothesis.py add an exclude_wet path: races over the threshold marked WET in the PRIMARY ceiling table and excluded from summary stats, printing the wet fraction. Do NOT touch mass_model.py. Physics test for the consumer (stored value / None).

preconditions.satisfied_by: wet columns populated in real DBs; verification values reproduce

postconditions.statement: physics consumer test passes; validation script flags/excludes wet races in PRIMARY section

constraints: physics reads STORED value only, no recompute
threshold is a named constant not a literal

m7-verify.title: Full verification: tests + populate + validate + simplification limits
m7-verify.imperative: Run all handoff verification commands foreground to completion: full new test suites, the populate run, the validate run showing wet races flagged/excluded, and simplification_limits --paths over every touched file. Capture evidence for the result.

postconditions.statement: tests pass, populate+validate produce the expected evidence, simplification_limits PASS

check.command: py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths src/data/weather_features.py src/data/database/_ingest.py src/data/database/_core.py scripts/populate_wet_features.py src/physics/burn_rate_calibration.py scripts/validate_burn_rate_hypothesis.py

constraints: all verification foreground to completion before writing result
